pins.head: A PINCH TINTS THE CUP
pins.title: Epoxy Resin Tips: Add Color a Pinch at a Time, Not a Spoonful
pins.desc: Epoxy resin tips about color all come down to how little you need. Mica powder goes in dry and pearly, pigment paste goes in thick and opaque, and either one will stop the resin curing properly once it passes a few percent of the mix. Tint one small cup first and hold it up to the light before you color the whole pour. Contains affiliate links. #ResinArt #MicaPowder #ResinColors
pins.alt: Three small clear cups on a pale concrete surface, one swirled deep teal, one pearly copper and one still clear, with a little wooden scoop of loose copper mica powder spilled in front of them.

pins.head: DRIED FLOWERS GO IN FLAT
pins.title: Resin Art for Beginners: Press the Flowers Flat Before They Go In
pins.desc: Resin art for beginners gets easier when the inclusions lie flat. Pressed and fully dried petals sit in a shallow pendant mold without floating up, so the front face stays smooth and the bail hole clears the edge. Lay out the findings and the chain before you mix, because a pendant has to be set while the resin is still open. Contains affiliate links. #ResinJewelry #ResinCrafts #HandmadeGifts
pins.alt: Three round clear resin pendants with pressed dried flowers inside, lying on a cream linen runner on a pale birch table beside a ceramic tray of gold bails and a chain, with a white silicone mold of oval cavities to the right.

pins.head: HOOKS OVER THE BENCH
pins.title: Renter Friendly Storage: An Entryway That Leaves No Holes
pins.desc: Renter friendly storage works hardest in the first three feet inside the door. A narrow bench gives shoes a landing place and baskets underneath take the ones that are not in use, adhesive hooks above it hold the bag and the scarf you reach for daily, and a shallow tray stops keys migrating into the rest of the apartment. Nothing here needs a drill. Contains affiliate links. #EntrywayIdeas #RenterFriendly #SmallSpaceLiving
pins.alt: A narrow oak bench against a warm white wall with two woven baskets on its lower shelf and a speckled ceramic tray on top, and three brushed metal adhesive hooks on the wall above holding a canvas tote, a mustard and grey scarf and a set of keys.

pins.head: LAY THE SECOND COLOR OVER
pins.title: Cricut Vinyl Tips: Line Up a Layered Decal With Gridded Tape
pins.desc: Cricut vinyl tips for layered designs all come down to registration. Transfer tape with a printed grid lets you line the second color up against the first before any adhesive touches down, and hinging the sheet from one edge keeps it from shifting as you press. Burnish the top layer only after both colors agree. Contains affiliate links. #VinylDecals #LayeredVinyl #TransferTape
pins.alt: A mustard yellow leaf decal on a grey stone tile with a teal flower decal on a sheet of gridded clear transfer tape laid across it ready to line up, a pale felt squeegee resting just behind on a dark walnut table.

pins.head: DEAD AIR AT FLOOR LEVEL
pins.title: Small Apartment Organization: Fill the Bay Under the Console
pins.desc: Small apartment organization works best where the storage already fits. The open bay under a low console is usually dead air, and woven baskets slid into it swallow remotes, cables and spare throws without adding a single piece of furniture to the room. Leave the top clear apart from a lamp so the wall above still reads as open. Contains affiliate links. #SmallSpaceLiving #LivingRoomStorage #ApartmentIdeas
pins.alt: A low oak media console against a pale grey wall with three woven seagrass baskets in the open bay underneath, a short row of books and a cream ceramic lamp on top, a jute rug below and an olive armchair at the right edge.

pins.head: A HOOK FOR EVERY CORNER
pins.title: Vinyl Weeding Tools: Hooks and Picks for Tight Inside Corners
pins.desc: Vinyl weeding tools earn their keep on the small shapes. A fine hook lifts the center of a letter without stretching it, a straight pick starts the edge of a long cut, and the rubber grips mean your fingers do not cramp halfway through a detailed decal. Keep them in the pouch so the tips stay sharp. Contains affiliate links. #VinylCrafts #CricutProjects #CraftTools
pins.alt: Five slim metal weeding tools with teal, coral, navy, purple and mint rubber grips fanned out on a green cutting mat, beside a half-weeded dark grey floral decal, loose vinyl scraps and a cream drawstring pouch holding more tools.
